verdict.rationale: HubSpot documents an official MCP server that gives any MCP-compatible agent read and write access to CRM data (contacts, deals, engagements), plus a contacts API that creates records via POST /crm/v3/objects/contacts. That covers the record-creation step of the story. The evidence does not show an agent filling company or firmographic data on the lead, or assigning an owner, through the API or MCP server. Missing for 10: documented company-data enrichment via API/MCP, documented owner assignment via API/MCP, end-to-end agent workflow example, independent or hands-on corroboration.
